definitions.gloss: business partner, client company, trading partner
definitions.explanation: A company or individual with whom one conducts business transactions. Can refer to clients, suppliers, or any party in a business relationship.

examples.japanese: {取引先|とりひきさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
{取引先|とりひきさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a meeting with a client company this afternoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{取引先|とりひきさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}している→強化する：25344_kyoukasuru⟧。
examples.english: We're strengthening our sales activities to develop new business partners.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Compound of ⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧ (business transaction) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination/party). The ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ suffix is common in business vocabulary to indicate the other party: ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧ (contact), {届|とど}け{先|さき} (delivery destination), ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れ：07431_shiire⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (supplier).

USAGE:
A core business vocabulary word. Used in workplace conversations, emails, and reports. {取引先|とりひきさき} is broader than "client" — it encompasses any company you do business with, whether they buy from you or you buy from them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取引先|とりひきさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}する→訪問する：26836_houmonsuru⟧: to visit a business partner
- {取引先|とりひきさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: relationship with a business partner
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{取引先|とりひきさき}: major business partner
- {取引先|とりひきさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop new business partners
